exact_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw a complete two-panel pencil construction storyboard for two NEW scenes, not finished art. Panel A: sunlit Ahmedabad rooftop terrace inside solid parapet, Buddy (charcoal dog with pale muzzle and paws) stands entirely within a rectangular sunny patch in foreground, head lowered appraising the warm tile, all four feet supported; Neet (tan dog with large triangular ears, fine legs and near-flush nub tail, dark gray little scarf) stands farther right gazing ambitiously skyward at distant kites. No humans needed in panel A, no fallen kite yet. Panel B: closer low camera view, same terrace later: Buddy has left the sun patch to join a cheer and stands mouth open looking upward in surprise at his own excitement; Neet beside him stands chest proudly lifted, mouth open toward a large golden kite falling high in distant sky. Both safely inside parapet, all feet on tiles, no jumping. A cropped adult woman's hand and arm at upper right holds a wooden kite spool, flying line slopes upward clear of dogs. Continuous spine/ribcage/pelvis/neck, correct four limb roots and supported toes, no overlap between dogs; show light construction lines. Neet smooth short fawn coat, cream muzzle/chest, modest head. Buddy moderately elongated full dark torso, substantial real legs and visible clearance, modest head and projecting pale moustache, light brows, softly hanging ears, slender dark tail, regional furnishings only. Photo inputs 1-3 are primary visual anatomy evidence only in visible regions; fourth is generated provisional model/style interpretation, never stronger evidence than photographs. No exaggerated sausage body, no giant heads, no shaggy torso. No lettering or speech balloons. Distinct compositions: wide spatial setup A, close spontaneous cheer B. Landscape sheet with two stacked wide frames, complete drawn environments.
